items.source: Subclasses can override this to supply dynamic SQL if they wish, but SQL is normally set by calling the setSql(String) method or in a subclass constructor.

items.source: Subclasses should set SQL and add parameters before invoking the compile() method. The order in which parameters are added is significant. The appropriate execute or update method can then be invoked.
items.translation: 子类应在调用compile()方法之前设置 SQL 并添加参数。参数的添加顺序很重要。然后可以调用适当的execute或update方法。

items.source: This class and subclasses throw runtime exceptions, defined in the org.springframework.dao package (and as thrown by the org.springframework.jdbc.core package, which the classes in this package use under the hood to perform raw JDBC operations).
items.translation: 该类及其子类会抛出在 `org.springframework.dao` 包中定义的运行时异常（这些异常也由 `org.springframework.jdbc.core` 包抛出，该包中的类在底层使用此包来执行原始 JDBC 操作）。

items.source: Parameter ordering is significant. This method is an alternative to the declareParameter(SqlParameter) method, which should normally be preferred.
items.translation: 参数顺序很重要。此方法是`declareParameter(SqlParameter)`方法的替代方案，通常应优先使用后者。

items.source: Automatically called by validateParameters.
items.translation: 由validateParameters自动调用。

items.source: Default is -1, indicating to use the JDBC driver's default.
items.translation: 默认值为 -1，表示使用 JDBC 驱动程序的默认值。

items.source:
The order in which this method is called is significant when using
positional parameters. It is not significant when using named parameters
with named SqlParameter objects here; it remains significant when using
named parameters in combination with unnamed SqlParameter objects here.
items.translation: 调用此方法的顺序在使用位置参数时至关重要。在使用此处带有命名 SqlParameter 对象的命名参数时，该顺序并不重要；但在结合使用此处未命名的 SqlParameter 对象与命名参数时，该顺序仍然重要。

items.source: Subclasses can assume that SQL and a DataSource have been supplied.
items.translation: 子类可以假定已提供 SQL 和 DataSource。

items.source: An alternative to the more commonly used setDataSource(DataSource) when you want to use the same JdbcTemplate in multiple RdbmsOperations. This is appropriate if the JdbcTemplate has special configuration such as a SQLExceptionTranslator to be reused.
items.translation: 当需要在多个 `RdbmsOperations` 中使用相同的 `JdbcTemplate` 时，这是比更常用的 setDataSource(DataSource) 的替代方案。如果 `JdbcTemplate` 具有需要重用的特殊配置（例如一个 `SQLExceptionTranslator`），则此方案是合适的。

items.source: An alternative to the more commonly used setDataSource(DataSource) when you want to use the same JdbcTemplate in multiple RdbmsOperations.
items.translation: 当需要在多个 `RdbmsOperations` 中使用相同的 `JdbcTemplate` 时，这是比更常用的 setDataSource(DataSource) 的替代方案。

Add one or more declared parameters. Used for configuring this operation
when used in a bean factory.  Each parameter will specify SQL type and (optionally)
the parameter's name.

items.source:
Is this operation "compiled"? Compilation, as in JDO,
means that the operation is fully configured, and ready to use.
The exact meaning of compilation will vary between subclasses.
items.translation: 此操作是否已“编译”？在 JDO 中，编译意味着该操作已完全配置并准备就绪。编译的具体含义将在不同子类之间有所差异。
